b4273062cb.text: The buyer is the City of Durham.

aec41fd5ff.text: The solicitation is Request for Proposal (RFP) #24-0031 for an Oracle ERP Implementation Partner.
aec41fd5ff.quote: Request for Proposal (RFP) #24-0031 For Oracle ERP Implementation Partner

fa9327572d.quote: Date of Issue: May 10, 2024 Due Date: June 10, 2024

db7ca2e370.text: The City invites qualified implementation partners to propose deployment and integration of Oracle ERP and Utility Billing solutions.
db7ca2e370.quote: The purpose of this request for proposal (RFP) is to invite qualified implementation partners to submit a proposal for the deployment and integration of Oracle's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Utility Billing solutions for the City of Durham in North Carolina (the City).

bbd359a8b5.text: The RFP sets the City’s requirements for Oracle solution implementation, customization, and operational integration.
bbd359a8b5.quote: This RFP outlines the City’s specific requirements regarding the implementation, customization, and operational integration of the Oracle solution.

298e956131.text: The City requires a partner with proven Oracle implementation expertise, particularly in local government utility billing.
298e956131.quote: The City requires a partner with proven expertise in effectively implementing Oracle's solutions, particularly in areas critical to local government operations such as utility billing (including customer accounts management, meter reading, and customer billing processes).

2c4f1e11ff.text: Proponents should demonstrate a comprehensive approach and experience succeeding on similar projects.
2c4f1e11ff.quote: Proponents should demonstrate a comprehensive approach to meet all the outlined requirements in this RFP, emphasizing their experience and success in similar projects.

397096b20b.text: This solicitation is the second phase of a two-step process.
397096b20b.quote: This solicitation represents the second phase of a two-step process.

62cb397108.text: The City selected Oracle as its enterprise software solution in the first phase.
62cb397108.quote: The first phase involved the selection of Oracle as the Enterprise software solution.

0c4d7bb425.text: This RFP seeks an implementation partner only.
0c4d7bb425.quote: This RFP focuses exclusively on seeking a partner for the implementation phase.

a3999015bc.text: The City intends to run a fair, transparent process to select a competent, compatible implementation partner.
a3999015bc.quote: The City is committed to a fair and transparent selection process, focusing on securing the most competent and compatible partner for this critical implementation phase.

f9d479bc85.text: The Operating Model guides operational decisions.
f9d479bc85.quote: The Operating Model, as depicted in the figure below, serves as a strategic framework guiding operational decisions.

80883c58db.text: The Operating Model defines system boundaries and scope and identifies which mega-processes receive implementation support.
80883c58db.quote: It plays a crucial role in defining the boundaries and scope of the system, as well as determining which mega-processes (represented by the grey bars in the middle) will receive implementation support.

debb73ff1b.text: The City and Info-Tech are advancing to implementation of the selected Oracle solution.
debb73ff1b.quote: The City, in collaboration with Info-Tech Research Group Inc (Info-Tech), is now advancing to the next critical phase of its enterprise solution journey – the implementation of the selected Oracle solution.

2f0c14f2f9.text: Implementation will follow a structured, collaborative approach using Info-Tech’s ERP implementation methodology.
2f0c14f2f9.quote: This process, integral to the successful deployment of the ERP and Utility Billing solutions, will be conducted through a structured and collaborative approach, adhering to the proven Info-Tech methodology for ERP Implementation projects.

6d5a09283d.text: The implementation remains aligned with the City’s business vision, goals, and previously established business requirements.
6d5a09283d.quote: The project continues to be strategically aligned with the City's business vision and goals, ensuring that the implementation phase is driven by the business requirements previously established.

b6318d5f86.text: The implementation partner will translate defined future business processes and IT requirements into a functional Oracle environment.
b6318d5f86.quote: The focus is now on partnering with a capable and experienced Oracle implementation partner, who will be instrumental in transforming the defined future business processes and IT requirements into a fully functional Oracle environment.

54fddc0a6e.text: The City will select a partner based on competency across several factors.
54fddc0a6e.quote: The City's Partner selection decision will be based on Partner’s competency evaluated across a number of factors.

b4a6b07d5a.text: Selection factors include government implementation experience, Oracle experience, collaboration, communication and support, methodology, viability, capability, references, cooperation, and price.
b4a6b07d5a.quote: Factors to be considered include State/City Implementation Experience, Oracle ERP Solution Implementation experience, Collaboration, Communication & Support, Implementation Methodology, Proponent viability, Proponent capability, customer references, willingness to work cooperatively, and overall price.

0194a68ceb.text: The City expects a business-critical relationship with the selected implementation partner.
0194a68ceb.quote: The City will be establishing a business-critical relationship with the Proponent whose implementation services are retained.

6a48a22877.text: The City requires a partner willing to cooperate and respect the City’s culture and wishes.
6a48a22877.quote: One of the most significant requirements of a Proponent is the Proponent’s willingness to work cooperatively with the City, respecting the City's culture and wishes.

6b5167f065.text: The City will view adherence to the selection process as an indicator of the future relationship.
6b5167f065.quote: The Proponent's willingness to adhere to the selection process set forth in this document will be viewed by the City as an indicator of the nature of the future relationship.

83b47824f5.text: The Underutilized Business Compliance Division handles initial submissions; Info-Tech’s consulting partner handles post-submission contact.
83b47824f5.quote: The City has designated their Underutilized Business Compliance Division for all initial proponent submissions and Info-Tech consulting partner as the post-submission proponent contact related to this RFP.

ed2b1d49a4.text: Send initial submissions to Underutilized Business Compliance Division at ubcfinance@durhamnc.gov and copy Ahmed Ebrahim at aebrahim@infotech.com; do not contact City personnel directly.
ed2b1d49a4.quote: Attention: Underutilized Business Compliance Division Email: ubcfinance@durhamnc.gov Copying: Ahmed Ebrahim Email: aebrahim@infotech.com UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES is the proponent to contact City personnel directly.

5c770e5f98.text: Direct all questions, marketing materials, and other contact through the identified City of Durham contact.
5c770e5f98.quote: All questions, marketing materials, and other forms of contact must be directed through the identified City of Durham Contact.

3a0ac06205.text: Contacting City personnel directly may lead to disqualification from the selection process.
3a0ac06205.quote: Violation of this request may cause a proponent to be deemed as unwilling to work in a harmonious manner with the City and result in the proponent's disqualification from the selection process.

4a96bebf2c.text: The RFP and resulting agreement are intended for all City departments and entities receiving City financial support.
4a96bebf2c.quote: The intended coverage of this RFP, and any agreement resulting from this solicitation, shall be for the use of all departments at the City as well as the entities for which City of Durham is providing financial support.

c84c3888cd.text: Proponents should generally follow “should” instructions to improve selection chances, but noncompliance does not automatically result in rejection.
c84c3888cd.quote: Proponents that want to increase the likelihood of being selected will, in general, do what the RFP says proponents “should” do, but failure to comply with all “shoulds” will not necessarily and automatically result in rejection.

5291e9dc63.text: The City anticipates contracting with the successful proponent to provide the software solution described in the RFP.
5291e9dc63.quote: The City anticipates that the conclusion of the RFP process will be a contract between the City and the successful proponent under which the successful proponent will provide the software solution generally described in this

75ac0f9cad.text: The City intends to use Appendix A, Model Services Contract, modified and completed to reflect the RFP and proposal.
75ac0f9cad.quote: It is the City’s intention to use the contract that is appended as RFP #24-0031– -Appendix A- Model Services Contract, modified and filled in to reflect the RFP and the proposal.

4eff890a54.text: Proponents should state any objections to the contract in their proposals.
4eff890a54.quote: If a proponent objects to any of the contract, it should state the objections in its proposal.

4d3ffdd158.text: Durham had a population of 283,506 in the 2020 Census.
4d3ffdd158.quote: With a population of 283,506 in the 2020 Census, Durham is the 4th-most populous city in North Carolina, and the 74th-most populous city in the United States.[8] The city is located in the east-central part of the Piedmont region along the Eno River.

4874778f49.text: Durham has become an educational, medical, and research center; it is home to Duke University and North Carolina Central University.
4874778f49.quote: While these industries have declined, Durham underwent revitalization and population growth[10] to become an educational, medical, and research center.[11] Durham is home to several recognized institutions of higher education, most notably Duke University and North Carolina Central University.

e0a14d5159.text: Duke and Duke University Health System are Durham’s largest employers.
e0a14d5159.quote: Duke and its Duke University Health System are the largest employers in the city.

47388aae4a.text: The City’s systems are largely unintegrated and disparate; some are unsupported and lack reporting capabilities.
47388aae4a.section: 2.3. Major drivers for Enterprise Resource Planning
47388aae4a.quote: The City operates in an environment of largely unintegrated disparate systems, some of which are unsupported and lack reporting capabilities.

c3ec948d17.text: Users across the City rely significantly on manual interactions.
c3ec948d17.section: 2.3. Major drivers for Enterprise Resource Planning
c3ec948d17.quote: The City operates through a significant amount of manual interaction from users across the entire organization.

9fa97f45fe.text: Some strategic processes are poorly supported by existing technologies.
9fa97f45fe.section: 2.3. Major drivers for Enterprise Resource Planning
9fa97f45fe.quote: In addition, some strategic processes are poorly supported by the existing technologies.

c9bcf57636.text: The City’s existing applications and manual tools do not adequately support needed business capabilities.
c9bcf57636.section: 2.3. Major drivers for Enterprise Resource Planning
c9bcf57636.quote: The existing ecosystem of applications (and supporting environment of manual tools) are not sufficient to support the needed business capabilities.

4dc3bca943.text: The lack of a single source of truth is a growing challenge as business and resident expectations increase.
4dc3bca943.section: 2.3. Major drivers for Enterprise Resource Planning
4dc3bca943.quote: As expectations from the business and residents increase, the absence of a single source of truth is emerging as a major challenge.

1a5dda8b7c.text: Multiple systems of record and departmental solutions create inefficiency and manual work that can inhibit process effectiveness.
1a5dda8b7c.section: 2.3. Major drivers for Enterprise Resource Planning
1a5dda8b7c.quote: Multiple systems of record, along with other departments’ local solutions, create an operating environment rampant with inefficiency and manual activity that can inhibit process effectiveness.

9de664f264.text: An accurate operational picture is expected to support long-term sustainability, rising community expectations, and continuous service improvement.
9de664f264.section: 2.3. Major drivers for Enterprise Resource Planning
9de664f264.quote: An accurate picture of the operations is expected to play a pivotal role in supporting the long-term sustainability, rising community expectations, and continuous improvement of services at the City.

fa2f0b0147.text: The solution must produce timely reports, integrate processes, and provide consistent corporate data across Finance, Budget & Management Services, Customer Billing Services, and Human Resources.
fa2f0b0147.section: 2.3. Major drivers for Enterprise Resource Planning
fa2f0b0147.quote: To support the City’s strategic direction, a solution must have the ability to produce efficient and timely reports to internal and external stakeholders, to integrate business processes, and to provide consistent corporate data across various users in multiple departments including the Finance Department, Budget & Management Services Department, The Customer Billing Services Division within the D

1ca72d924b.text: Multiple systems of record duplicate data and complicate data access, cross-checking, and reporting.
1ca72d924b.section: 2.3. Major drivers for Enterprise Resource Planning
1ca72d924b.quote: • Multiple systems of record resulting in the duplication of data, complicating data availability, cross checking, and reporting.

addcb2b40d.text: Manual processes and poor visibility across disparate systems create inconsistent information.
addcb2b40d.section: 2.3. Major drivers for Enterprise Resource Planning
addcb2b40d.quote: • Manual processes and lack of visibility into disparate systems creating inconsistent information.

73512a8aa3.text: Time-consuming reconciliation and poor visibility across disparate systems produce inconsistent answers to the same questions.
73512a8aa3.section: 2.3. Major drivers for Enterprise Resource Planning
73512a8aa3.quote: • Time-consuming data reconciliation processes and lack of visibility into disparate systems, creating inconsistent answers to the same questions.

2fe52a38ec.text: Without aggregate data from a single integrated, reliable information set, the City cannot make data-driven business decisions.
